title: TEMPO Metronome App | Steady from the first beat, practice room to stage
desc: TEMPO is a metronome app that saves BPM and meter for every song, cues each section by voice, and adds a drum machine and tempo practice tools. For drums, guitar, piano, bands and worship teams. Free to start.
lead:
Lock in the click, build the groove,
and take your setlist to the stage.
hero_alt: TEMPO screen: 110 BPM, per-beat accents and a large play button
release_p: The new features below arrive after App Store review. Android timing will be announced separately.
intro_h2:
What you need to practice.
What you keep for the stage.
intro_p: Leave the beat and settings to TEMPO. Keep your focus on playing.
pb_h2:
On to the next section.
Never lose the flow.
pb_p: Intro · Verse · Chorus · Bridge · Ending. Save the sections and bar counts of each song, and get a voice cue before the next part begins.
pb_li: Switch only the bars you need from 4/4 to 2/4
Count-in per song · current section and bar on screen
From the Ending, jump straight into the next song's count-in
Tap a section to set bar count, name, order or duplicate it
pb_note: Clicks and section cues only. It does not play backing tracks.
pb_alt: Playback screen editing bar counts for Intro, Verse, Chorus and Ending
mm_h2:
Even one short bar.
With a simple tap.
mm_p: Change only bar 4 of the Verse to 2/4: that bar plays two beats, and the next bar returns to 4/4. No need to split and rebuild the whole section.
mm_steps: Tap a section → choose the bar to make 2/4 → Done
mm_alt: Editor with bar 4 of an 8-bar Verse set to 2/4
dm_h2:
After the click,
your own groove.
dm_p: Build beats on four tracks: kick, snare, hi-hat and ride. Start from basic beats or shuffle, jazz and bossa nova presets, then tap the steps to edit the pattern.
dm_li: Save the current pattern on your device
dm_secret: Hidden tool: tap the DailyDrum logo on the Tempo tab 8 times quickly.
dm_alt: Pattern editor with four drum tracks, 16th/triplet grid and swing
list_h3:
Prepare every song.
Share the whole list.
list_p: Save BPM, time signature, subdivision and count-in for each song. Organize them in folders and send them as a file; the other person imports it as a new list.
list_alt: Setlist with each song's BPM, note value and count-in
live_p: Move to the next song and your saved voice count-in gets you ready. Quick BPM, meter and subdivision changes right on screen. TEMPO ANCHOR re-locks the beat while keeping your sound and downbeat accent.
live_note: Count-in per song · large controls · no ads in Live
live_alt: Live screen with song order, large play button and TEMPO ANCHOR
pr_p: Pick songs and practice settings together in List. The Automator moves the tempo toward your target BPM, and the Tracker moves to the next song after the bars or time you set.
pr_note: Bars · time · timer · settings in a pop-up
pr_alt: Automator and Tracker settings opened over the List
vs_h3:
A clear reference,
tuned to your ear.
vs_p: Bella joins the English voices, Digital and Gentle are newly recorded, and an Acoustic sound is added. Adjust volume, pitch and length, plus accent or mute for each beat.
vs_note: TAP with your chosen sound · voices in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional)
vs_alt: Settings for click sounds, pitch and sound length
new_items: Edit sections and bars, count-ins and voice cues for the next part. Turn any bar of a 4/4 song into 2/4.
Digital, Gentle and Acoustic now have separate accent and regular hits, with clearer control at high volume.
Hear your selected click in TAP, and keep your saved downbeat accent in Tempo Anchor.
Control the Automator and Tracker from a compact settings window, with a balanced play bar at the bottom.
pro_p: A one-time in-app upgrade, not a separate app. It is not a subscription.
pro_li: Removes all ads in the app
Restore on the same Apple ID
pro_note: Check the final price on the App Store purchase screen. Purchase may be unavailable until the product passes review.
free_p1: Use the metronome, List, Live and one Playback song. Any extra Playback setups you already saved are kept, not deleted.
free_p2: Ads appear only in the banner areas of Tempo and List. Live and Playback show no ads.
